categories.evidence: Carries the P2P label and modifies block serving logic in `src/net_processing.cpp` for `MSG_BLOCK` requests.

While legacy `MSG_BLOCK` traffic is currently minor, this mitigates resource overhead when serving blocks and unblocks proposed witnessless IBD (#36476).
